copy.tagline_en: Integrate Google Chat messaging into your application

howto.what: Claude 会自动完成 Google Chat 适配器的复制、注册、依赖安装、构建和测试，并引导你在 Google Cloud 控制台创建凭据、写入 .env。此后消息收发还需人工完成配置。
howto.when: 通常在你说要接入 Google Chat、或运行 /setup 流程需要配置频道时触发。

say.text: 给我的项目接入 Google Chat
say.note: 开始执行适配器复制、注册和测试。

say.text: 运行 /setup 时加上 Google Chat
say.note: 在初始化流程中接入该渠道。

say.text: 把 Google Chat 绑定到 agent 组

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Google Chat adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs the pinned dependency, builds, runs the integration test, then guides you through Google Cloud setup and storing credentials in .env. Manual setup is still required for live messages.
howto.when_en: Typically triggers when you ask to add Google Chat or when a /setup flow needs a channel configured.

say_en.text: Add Google Chat to my project
say_en.note: Runs adapter copy, registration, and tests.
Adds the channel in the setup flow.
